notes:
Summary: Veridian IDEWorks is building an internal enterprise code assistant for regulated trading desks and developer teams. Key asks: low-latency streaming completions inside VS Code and JetBrains IDEs, fine-grained model/version pinning (must pin to vetted instruction-tuned model), and strong audit/logging + retention for compliance audits. They view Redwood as a candidate because of private/VPC deployment and observability features.

Quoted from CTO Ravi Patel: "We need an auditable trail for every suggestion — if compliance asks, we must show who saw what and what model generated the code."

Performance targets: p50 ~40-80ms for single-line completions, p95 < 200ms for interactive streaming; throughput to support ~120 active devs concurrently during peak, scale to 1000+ in production. Cost sensitivity: moderate-high — willing to pay for dedicated capacity but want Optimize recommendations to lower token costs.

Security/Compliance: Require SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning, KMS integration (customer-managed keys), immutable audit logs retained for 24 months, and option for EU-only backups for certain business units. Air-gapped on-prem package flagged for quant team but lower priority.

POC scope: 2-week VPC-hosted proof (private control plane) with VS Code extension and a JetBrains plugin, model pinned to rwi-*-v2 (example), streaming enabled, audit log shipping to SIEM, and cost telemetry. Success criteria: latency targets met, audit log completeness validated, and no leakage of repo secrets in suggestions.

Sales notes / coms: Jordan to send updated POC SOW and draft NDA (actioned). Elena to produce detailed runbook + security checklist by 2026-03-15. Procurement wants pricing for 12-month reserved capacity and add-on for extended log retention.

Open questions: exact retention format (raw tokens vs metadata), legal approval timeline, and whether the trading desk will require air-gapped enclave.
